parties: Sarvpriya Securities Pvt Ltd (acquirer); Signatureglobal (India) Limited (target)
headline: Sarvpriya Securities Discloses Substantial Share Acquisition in Signatureglobal (India) Limited
sum: Pradeep Kumar Aggarwal, Lalit Kumar Aggarwal, Ravi Aggarwal and Devendra Aggarwal, acting through Sarvpriya Securities Pvt Ltd, filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial share acquisition in Signatureglobal (India) Limited to the NSE on 24 June 2026.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures signal entry into 5–10% slab or crossing thresholds toward 25% trigger for mandatory open offer; the named promoters' use of a special-purpose entity (Sarvpriya Securities) suggests structuring of control and disclosure strategy under the Takeover Code.
detail: The Aggarwal brothers—Pradeep Kumar, Lalit Kumar, Ravi, and Devendra—acting together through Sarvpriya Securities Pvt Ltd, filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011 (Takeover Code). This filing arises from a substantial acquisition of shares in Signatureglobal (India) Limited, a real-estate developer. The disclosure was submitted to the NSE as prescribed by Regulation 31(4), which requires parties to notify stock exchanges upon crossing prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, etc.). The specific acquisition value and shareholding percentage are not disclosed in the headline; the full disclosure document filed with the exchange would contain those details.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011
triggers.note: Regulation 31(4) disclosure mandatory upon crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 25% or higher thresholds of voting rights.
If 25% threshold crossed, mandatory open offer triggered unless exempted by SEBI (e.g., under Regulation 6 for acquisitions from single seller or in agreement with target board).
